title: Buyer says there is NO court case, FIR or insolvency
turns: Flat in Miyapur, Hyderabad, project Silver Oak by Trident Homes, RERA registered. Possession was promised by 31 March 2024, I have paid 44 lakh and I want the flat with delay interest. To be clear: there is no case pending anywhere, I have not filed any FIR, and the builder is not bankrupt.
